svg.title: MonoLisa Code grade adjustment at a fixed Regular weight
svg.desc: The same line at wght 400 and GRAD -50, 0, and +50, showing progressively thicker strokes at the same Regular weight. All three lines have a measured advance of 322.59375 SVG units at 28 px. Fixed spacing also holds when weight changes in MonoLisa Code and JetBrains Mono; it is not a grade-specific advantage in this comparison. Ligatures are disabled; no glyphs are replaced or scaled independently.
